verdict.rationale: Versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy are a fair axis for a payments API platform like Checkout.com, so the story applies. Nothing in the pack covers it: the docs items describe payment, platform and issuing features, and the probes found an llms.txt file but no OpenAPI spec. None of this mentions API versioning or deprecation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
